description: RL1 (PS §3.2, PR §8.3): try_program — series, event (`consecutive`, `isolated`), signal (`simulated` records) and state summaries; the work budget stops a run; from the same `from_t` the try's events equal the document's event series (more than zero); a reader without the data is `no_entitlement`.
name: 73-program-try

steps.note: Series and event summaries over the closed bars: `events`, `runs`, `notifications`, `consecutive`, `isolated`, first/last events with `known_t`.

query.source:
param len int = 5 in 2..50
m = sma(close, len)
series avg = m
event up = close > m and defined(m)

steps.note: Signal records (`mode: replay`, `label: simulated`) and state keys.

query.source:
r = rsi(close, 14)
entry = cooldown(cross_below(r, 30), 12)
signal rsi_dip = entry side al target 3% stop 1.5% max_bars 24 source "rsi_dip" "1"
state zone { lvl = bucket(r, [30, 50, 70]) }

steps.note: 20 000 bars and four signals open on every bar: the run stops at `program.try.max_work` (`stopped: budget`); what came before stands.

query.source:
e = close > 0 or stdev(close, 640) > 0
signal a = e side al target 900% stop 90% max_bars 500 source "a" "1"
signal b = e side al target 900% stop 90% max_bars 500 source "b" "1"
signal c = e side al target 900% stop 90% max_bars 500 source "c" "1"
signal d = e side al target 900% stop 90% max_bars 500 source "d" "1"

steps.note: The program in the document; its `since_t` precedes every bar.
Try of the instance from the same `from_t`.
The document's event series: its event bars are the try's (more than zero).
